entries.name: stone
entries.description: Weathered grey field stone in object space: broad tonal noise, large worley cracks with relief, moss on up-facing tops (param moss, 0 = clean).
entries.prompt: Stylized rock material for the friendSLOP meadow rocks and pebbles.

entries.name: bark
entries.description: Rough bark in object space: ridged fbm streaks, blotchy tone, param burn (0..1) chars it toward black.

entries.name: ash
entries.description: Fire-pit ash, 1 m tile: grey-black fbm with emissive ember flecks (worley f1 cells).

entries.name: flame
entries.description: Flame in object space: emissive vertical gradient from pale yellow at y=0 to deep red at 1.3 m, noise-wobbled.

entries.name: mushroom-cap
entries.description: Mushroom cap: brown-orange fbm with cream worley spots on top, pale gills underneath (facing).

entries.name: gunmetal
entries.description: Blued gun steel in object space: dark metallic fbm, edge wear to bright steel on convex mesh curvature.

entries.name: grip-wood
entries.description: Varnished walnut grip in object space: warped growth rings, light clearcoat.

entries.name: leaf
entries.description: Foliage green in object space: fbm greens, mesh AO darkens the insides of clumps; params hue (turns) and light.

entries.name: grass
entries.description: Grass blade: dark at the root to pale yellow-green at param top (m), noise-wobbled; param hue.

entries.name: petal
entries.description: Flower petal: pink fbm, params hue (turns), sat and val to recolour (yellow centres, white, purple).
